annotations.title: utilpeek: get ECB foreign-exchange reference rates

description: utilpeek: foreign-exchange reference rates for a base currency. For live on-chain rates use get_live_fx_rates. Unknown currencies and older dates are a 422 (not charged); an ECB outage is a 5xx (not charged). Typically under 0.1 s (up to 10 s on a refresh). Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Rates are the European Central Bank (ECB) euro reference rates, available free of charge at ecb.europa.eu; non-EUR bases are cross rates computed by Tanod. For information purposes only, not for transactions (`attribution` carries the ECB terms). Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/exchange-rates-api.html

base.description: Base currency (ISO 4217, e.g. USD), or EUR.
base.title: Base

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD within the last 90 days (default: latest).
date.title: Date

symbols.description: Optional: 1-40 ISO 4217 codes to return (default: all ECB currencies).
symbols.title: Symbols

name: get_fx_rates

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
